title: Brotli compressed data format
summary: Brotli is a compression format developed by Google, optimized for web content. A Brotli stream: window size (WBITS), then meta-blocks. Each meta-block: ISLAST (1 bit), ISUNCOMPRESSED (1 bit), optional data length (MLEN), then block data (literals with context modeling + backward references with a large window up to 16MB).

ext.summary: Brotli is a compression format developed by Google, optimized for web content. A Brotli stream: window size (WBITS), then meta-blocks. Each meta-block: ISLAST (1 bit), ISUNCOMPRESSED (1 bit), optional data length (MLEN), then block data (literals with context modeling + backward references with a large window up to 16MB).

structure.meaning: Window size: 0-15 (16-17) or 16-30 (1MB-16MB window). Encoded as a variable-length code.
1 if this is the last meta-block.
1 if the meta-block is stored uncompressed.
Number of nibbles for MLEN (0 = no MLEN, 1-3 = 1-3 nibbles).
Literals (context-dependent Huffman) + backward references (distance + length, with a 120-entry static dictionary for common web terms).
No explicit trailer; the stream ends with ISLAST=1.

ext.example_decoded: Brotli: WBITS 16 (1MB window), empty stream (ISLAST=1, ISUNCOMPRESSED=0, MLEN=0)
notes: Brotli's static dictionary contains ~13,000 common words/phrases from web content, improving compression of HTML/CSS/JS.
Window size up to 16MB (WBITS up to 30).
Brotli is used by HTTPS (Content-Encoding: br), WOFF2 fonts, and many web servers.
Compression levels 0-11; higher levels are slower but compress better.
